events.verdict: White (BOS) dislodges the ball from Duren (DET) in the post.  The ensuing contact that occurs after the dislodge is considered incidental.
Pritchard (BOS) makes contact with the ball as Duren (DET) is starting his upward shooting motion.
Brown (BOS) makes contact with the ball as he defends Duren's (DET) shot attempt.
Harris (DET) dislodges the ball from Brown (BOS).
White (BOS) initially makes contact with the ball, however he slides his hand off the ball and initiates contact with Duren's (DET) arm/wrist as he is starting his upward shooting motion.
LeVert (DET) pulls White's (BOS) jersey away from his body and affects his FOM off-ball.
Brown (BOS) briefly grasps Duren's (DET) jersey before immediately releasing him.
Duren (DET) jumps forward into Brown's (BOS) body and initiates contact as he defends the shot attempt.
Cunningham (DET) is bracing for the contact from Scheierman (BOS) and he releases away from the contact during his shot attempt.
Walsh (BOS) jumps alongside Cunningham's (DET) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Duren (DET) makes contact with the rim after the ball bounces off the rim and no longer has a chance to score.
Walsh (BOS) makes contact with Thompson's (DET) arm that causes him to lose control of the ball.
Cunningham (DET) brings his forearm to Scheierman's (BOS) back as he releases away to pursue the rebound.
Pritchard (BOS) steps into Cunningham's (DET) space and initiates contact that affects Cunningham's SQBR.
LeVert (DET) legally contests White's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Stewart (DET) establishes himself in Scheierman's (BOS) path prior to the contact.
Walsh (BOS) legally contests Cunningham's (DET) shot attempt.
Scheierman (BOS) contests Cunningham's (DET) shot attempt and the contact after the release is marginal.
Scheierman (BOS) and Stewart (DET) come together as they pursue the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Pritchard (BOS) momentarily applies his arm to Cunningham's (DET) left arm as Cunningham brings his left hand to the ball.

Stewart (DET) brushes the back of Walsh's (BOS) head as the two position themselves for a potential rebound. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Stewart (DET) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Harris (DET) legally contests Brown's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Thompson (DET) momentarily applies his hands to Scheierman's (BOS) side and immediately removes his hands as he releases away.
Cunningham's (DET) left hand comes forward towards Scheierman (BOS) as he stops his forward momentum, and the contact is marginal.
Scheierman (BOS) legally contests Cunningham's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Walsh (BOS) momentarily grasps Thompson's (DET) jersey during the rebounding opportunity.
Cunningham (DET) and Walsh (BOS) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.
White (BOS) makes contact with the ball, and with the part of Cunningham's (DET) hand that is on the ball.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Cunningham (DET) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Celtics.
White (BOS) establishes himself in Thompson's (DET) path prior to the contact.
Thompson (DET) brushes White's (BOS) arm as he moves to receive the pass.
White (BOS) does not step out of bounds while he is in contact with the ball.
Harris (DET) commits a take foul on White (BOS).
Scheierman (BOS) commits a take foul on Cunningham (DET). The contact occurs prior to the start of Cunningham's upward shooting motion, and a non-shooting foul is correctly assessed.
White (BOS) signals for, and is granted, a timeout within five seconds.
Cunningham (DET) and Pritchard (BOS) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.
Brown (BOS) briefly grasps LeVert's (DET) jersey during the inbound.
LeVert (DET) briefly grasps Brown's (BOS) jersey as he deflects the ball away from Brown.
The ball is deflected by LeVert (DET) and Simons (BOS) legally gains possession of the ball in the backcourt.
Cunningham (DET) commits a take foul on Simons (BOS).

Walsh (BOS) initiates contact with Cunningham's (DET) arm that occurs after the start of Cunningham's  upward shooting motion, and a shooting foul is correctly called on this play.  The game clock continues to run and, after communicating with the Replay Center, the game clock is correctly reset to 4.4 seconds.
The ball exits the imaginary cylinder above the basket ring before Williams (BOS) makes contact with the ball.
Thompson (DET) commits a take foul on Pritchard (BOS).
